## Genotyping post-imputation pipeline steps {.tabset}

***

Genotypes were imputed on the [TOPMed Imputation Server](https://imputation.biodatacatalyst.nhlbi.nih.gov/).
From the workflow dir run `mkdir -p ../results/04GENOTYPES-POST/TOPMED/` and copy the imputed output files into that directory.

***

```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(DT)
library(glue)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)

# Set variables from params (paths are relative to workflow/)
impute_summary <- params$impute_summary
eigenval_file <- params$eigenval
chromosomes <- strsplit(params$chromosomes, ",")[[1]]
hwe <- params$hwe
maf <- params$maf
rsq <- params$rsq
pcs <- params$pcs
bmark_dir <- params$bmark_dir
```

Rules:

1. `impute_check`: Evaluate imputation quality for each chromosome
2. `impute_check_cat`: Cat impute check counts for each chr into single file
3. `dwnld_dbsnp_ref`: Download dbSNP reference
4. `add_rsID`: Add dbSNP rsIDs to each imputed chr-specific VCF file
5. `vcf_cat`: Cat imputed chr-specific VCF files into single file
6. `filter_tags`: Compute HWE and filter the concatenated VCF; keep SNPs passing the HWE, MAF and R^2 thresholds
7. `check_VCF`: Validate the filt VCF against ref genome and ID problematic SNPs
8. `exclude_SNPs`: Exclude SNPs IDed in CheckVCF
9. `idx_vcf`: Index the final filtered VCF
10. `get_sample_list`: Extract final sample list
11. `vcf_to_plink`: Convert genotypes VCF to plink format
12. `get_ld_pruned_snps`: LD prune SNPs before running PCA on genotypes (`--indep-pairwise 250 5 0.2`)
13. `prune_genotypes`: Create genotypes plink-format file containing only pruned SNPs
14. `calc_genotype_pcs`: Run PCA on pruned genotypes to get genotype-specific PC covariates
15. `geno_post_report`: Generate this report

***

Settings:

```{r settings, echo = FALSE}
tibble(
  Setting = c("filter_tags: exclude SNPs with HWE p <",
              "filter_tags: exclude SNPs with MAF (INFO/MAF) <",
              "filter_tags: exclude SNPs with imputation R^2 (INFO/R2) <",
              "calc_genotype_pcs: number of genotype PCs"),
  Value   = c(hwe, maf, rsq, pcs)
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

***

### Check imputation

```{r, check_imputation_tbl, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
imp_check_tbl <- read_tsv(impute_summary)

# Create the GT table
imp_check_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  # Add a title and subtitle
  tab_header(
    title = "Imputation Quality Summary by Chromosome",
    subtitle = "Metrics include SNP counts, MAF, and R² thresholds"
  ) %>%
  # Customize column labels for clarity
  cols_label(
    chr = "Chromosome",
    snp_count = "Total SNPs",
    maf_lt_0.05 = "MAF < 0.05",
    maf_gteq_0.05 = "MAF ≥ 0.05",
    rsq_lt_0.08 = "R² < 0.8",
    rsq_gteq_0.08 = "R² ≥ 0.8",
    maf_gteq_0.05_rsq_gteq_0.08 = "MAF ≥ 0.05 & R² ≥ 0.8"
  ) %>%
  # Format numbers with commas for readability
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(snp_count, maf_lt_0.05, maf_gteq_0.05, rsq_lt_0.08, rsq_gteq_0.08, maf_gteq_0.05_rsq_gteq_0.08),
    decimals = 0,
    use_seps = TRUE
  ) %>%
  # Apply a color scale to highlight high/low values in numeric columns
  data_color(
    columns = c(snp_count, maf_lt_0.05, maf_gteq_0.05, rsq_lt_0.08, rsq_gteq_0.08, maf_gteq_0.05_rsq_gteq_0.08),
    palette = "viridis",
    domain = NULL
  ) %>%
  # Emphasize the "Overall" row with bold text
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = chr == "Overall")
  ) %>%
  # Adjust column alignment
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything()
  ) %>%
  # Apply a clean theme
  gt_theme_538() %>%
  # Add a footnote for context
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "MAF: Minor Allele Frequency; R²: Imputation quality score. Data includes chromosomes 1-22, X and overall totals.",
    locations = cells_title(groups = "subtitle")
  ) %>%
  # Set table width and font size
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100),
    table.font.size = 14,
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  )
```

***

### Genotype PCs

```{r, genotype_PCs, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
eigenval <- read_table(eigenval_file, col_names = "eigenval")

# calculate proportion and cumulative variance explained
variance <- eigenval %>%
  mutate(PC = row_number(),
         variance_explained = eigenval / sum(eigenval) * 100,
         cumulative = cumsum(variance_explained))

# elbow plot
p <- ggplot(variance, aes(x = PC, y = variance_explained)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Principal Component",
    y = "Variance Explained (%)",
    title = "Genotype PCA Variance Explained"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )
p
```


***

### Benchmarking {.tabset}

***

#### Table

```{r benchmarking, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Benchmark files: reports/benchmarks/04genotypes_post_impute.<rule>[_<wildcards>].benchmark.txt
# Files are matched against the current rules (impute_check_cat before impute_check);
# per-chromosome jobs are pooled under their rule and only current chromosomes are kept
smk_rules <- c("impute_check_cat", "impute_check", "dwnld_dbsnp_ref", "add_rsID",
               "vcf_cat", "filter_tags", "check_VCF", "exclude_SNPs", "idx_vcf",
               "get_sample_list", "vcf_to_plink", "get_ld_pruned_snps", "prune_genotypes",
               "calc_genotype_pcs", "geno_post_report")
valid_wildcards <- c("", chromosomes)

files <- list.files(bmark_dir, pattern = "^04genotypes_post_impute\\..*\\.benchmark\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

benchmarks <- map_dfr(files, function(f) {
  stem <- str_remove(basename(f), "^04genotypes_post_impute\\.") |> str_remove("\\.benchmark\\.txt$")
  rule <- smk_rules[stem == smk_rules | startsWith(stem, paste0(smk_rules, "_"))][1]
  if (is.na(rule)) return(NULL)
  wildcards <- str_remove(stem, paste0("^", rule, "_?"))
  if (!wildcards %in% valid_wildcards) return(NULL)
  df <- read.table(f, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")

  tibble(
    file = f,
    rule = rule,
    runtime_sec = df$s,
    runtime_hms = df$h.m.s.,
    max_rss = df$max_rss
  )
})

# Summarise by rule
summary <- benchmarks %>%
  group_by(rule) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_runtime_min = mean(runtime_sec) / 60,
    sd_runtime_min = sd(runtime_sec) / 60,
    mean_ram_gb = mean(max_rss) / 1024,
    sd_ram_gb = sd(max_rss) / 1024,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_runtime_min = if_else(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min),
    sd_ram_gb = if_else(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb)
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) %>%
  arrange(rule)

# Table
summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Table 2. Benchmarking",
    subtitle = "Means and SD across replicates"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    rule = "Rule",
    n = "N",
    mean_runtime_min = "Mean Runtime (min)",
    sd_runtime_min = "SD Runtime (min)",
    mean_ram_gb = "Mean RAM (GB)",
    sd_ram_gb = "SD RAM (GB)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(mean_runtime_min, sd_runtime_min, mean_ram_gb, sd_ram_gb),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14),
    table.border.top.style = "none",
    table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.color = "black",
    heading.align = "center"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  )
```

***

#### Plot

***

```{r, runtime_plt, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim=c(10, 5)}
runtime_plt <- ggplot(summary, aes(x = reorder(rule, mean_runtime_min),
                                 y = mean_runtime_min)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_runtime_min - ifelse(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min), 0),
                    ymax = mean_runtime_min + ifelse(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min)),
                width = 0.3, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Rule", y = "Runtime (minutes)",
       title = "Mean runtime per rule") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

mem_plt <- ggplot(summary, aes(x = reorder(rule, mean_ram_gb),
                                y = mean_ram_gb)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_ram_gb - ifelse(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb), 0),
                    ymax = mean_ram_gb + ifelse(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb)),
                width = 0.3, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Rule", y = "RAM (GB)",
       title = "Mean RAM usage per rule") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

plot_grid(runtime_plt, mem_plt)
```
